title: The Fallen Scion
text: A body in good armour lies under a cairn the weather has pulled apart, the stones scattered, the bones still neat inside the plate. The sigil on its shield belongs to no House you know. The seal on the letters in its satchel is still unbroken.

outcomes.text: It takes an hour, and nobody minds. The wind stops while you work.
It fits, perfectly, as if it was made for the one wearing it now. Nobody says anything for a while.

options.label: The wisest breaks the seals and reads the letters.

outcomes.text: They tell of a House that held this place once, and what it found here, and why nobody remembers them.
